text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23343e

g.text: The stronger current-history inverse raises force variation, so new robot corrections are rarely permitted.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23343e

g.text: Both force traces remain within ±0.5 N. Full inverse: 0.274 N peak, but only 6 eligible robot command decisions before the stop.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23343e

g.text: Partial inverse: 0.294 N peak; all 4 s complete and final stroke is 6.94 mm from center. Gate color indicates ready; gray indicates closed.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23343e

g.text: The full inverse stops before the 2.592 s sharp bump and fails the complete-episode requirement.
